maria_legal: I'll export the subprocessor CSV and draft a one-page attestation. BYOK onboarding for EU production typically 3-7 business days post-contract.

presales_bot: Created ticket PRESALES-8091 and runbook at https://internal.redwood/presales/PRESALES-8091. Assigned @raj_sre @tara_solutions.

nick_sales: Deliverables: (1) subprocessor CSV + one-pager, (2) POC attestation + test script, (3) ballpark uplift text for deck. Can we get these by tomorrow EOD?

tara_solutions: Yes, I'll prepare the one-pager and the curl test.

raj_sre: I'll prepare the attestation, ops checklist, and include a rough uplift: Dedicated regional pin ~+25%-+35% depending on GPU and locality; BYOK & retention are additional fees.
